title: O Happy Day Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: With a name like "O Happy Day," you can expect to smile as soon as you spot this charming cottage located right next to the Gulf in Seaside, Florida. The character-rich cottage features whimsical decor and an open floor plan.
description_expanded: Description61 SAVANNAH STREET - 2 Kings, 1 Queen, 2 Queen Sleeper Sofas - Sleeps 10O Happy Day – Prime Seaside Location Steps from the BeachWelcome to O Happy Day, a charming Seaside, Florida retreat located just 355 feet from beach access and a short, easy walk to Central Square. From your front door, enjoy effortless access to over 40 shops, restaurants, and Seaside’s vibrant coastal atmosphere. Instantly recognizable by its cheerful bright orange exterior, this inviting cottage blends timeless Seaside character with thoughtful modern updates. Guests will appreciate private driveway parking for two vehicles and a welcoming screened front porch with rocking chairs and a porch swing—perfect for slow mornings or relaxing after a day on the Gulf.Light-Filled Living & Open Gathering SpacesInside, the home opens to a bright and airy living space with soaring ceilings and designer furnishings that create a relaxed yet elevated feel. The comfortable living area features a large flat-screen TV, two club chairs, and a spacious queen sleeper sofa, offering an ideal setting for gathering or unwinding. The open-concept layout flows into a dedicated dining room with a farmhouse table seating eight, while the well-appointed kitchen is designed for both function and style. Highlights include granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, a four-burner electric cooktop, a double-door refrigerator with water dispenser, dishwasher, and ample built-in cabinetry. Bar seating for two provides a casual dining option, while a side foyer offers convenient access to the outdoor grill area. A rear laundry room with a full-size washer and dryer adds everyday convenience.Private Outdoor Living & Gated YardJust off the main living and dining areas, a rear screened porch creates an inviting outdoor lounge space with a sofa and club chair. This peaceful setting opens to a fully fenced and gated private yard that extends from front to back—an uncommon feature in Seaside. Enjoy al fresco dining at the picnic table, relax on the lush lawn, or start your day with morning yoga in a quiet, private setting. An outdoor shower with direct access to the laundry and wet room makes post-beach cleanup simple and seamless.Comfortable Bedrooms for Every GuestThe first floor offers two well-appointed guest bedrooms. The king bedroom features French doors opening to the front porch, a closet, and access to a shared hall bath with an updated vanity and tub/shower combination. The queen suite includes dual closets, a dresser, and French doors leading to the rear screened porch, along with a private ensuite bath featuring a single vanity and walk-in shower.Upstairs, the primary suite provides a serene retreat with a king bed, generous closet space, and an ensuite bath with dual vanities and a tub/shower combination. A staircase leads to the third-floor enclosed tower room, offering an additional queen sleeper sofa—perfect for accommodating extra guests. Just beyond, an open-air Juliet balcony invites you to take in sunset views over Seaside from a unique elevated perspective.Prime Location in the Heart of SeasideWith its exceptional proximity to the beach, Central Square, and Seaside’s renowned collection of shops and dining, O Happy Day delivers the perfect balance of charm, comfort, and convenience. Whether you’re planning a family getaway or a relaxing coastal escape, this home offers a memorable stay in one of 30A’s most sought-after locations.Additional FeaturesOutdoor charcoal grill, full-size washer and dryer, private driveway parking, and convenient outdoor shower access.* 5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 3-night minimum Fall; 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registrationFEATURESApproximately 2,062 Square feet2-minute walk, 335 feet to beach access at Savannah Pavilion; largest residential beaches on 30A Outdoor shower on side of home with access to laundry homeOutdoor charcoal grillPrivate driveway with off street parking for onePeacock Alley Linens - Fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 Clay tennis & 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay and starter amenities provided2 parking passes are issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit. No smoking allowed, of any kind inside or outside (including vaping and cigars). Additional cleaning fees will apply to repaint. No pets allowedSTR23-002143
